verdict.rationale: The official GitHub repository presents Activepieces as "an open source replacement for Zapier," and the vendor's llms.txt calls it open-source. A community commenter separately notes the MIT license, so the source is publicly readable under an open license. Missing for 10: a first-party statement in the pack naming the license and its scope (e.g., whether any enterprise or paid features fall under a different license); the MIT mention comes only from a launch-era community comment.
